mediator_designs.rationale: Guarantees mutual delegation results in fair trades, but prevents unilateral delegation from forcing me into a mediated exchange where the other side could defect; cancel avoids one-sided disadvantage. Mediation fee is only paid when delegation occurs.

Ensure mediated trades only complete when both parties opt in (fair execution with 2 delegators). If only one party delegates, cancel to prevent unilateral exploitation and preserve partner willingness.
Use execute_fair only when both sides delegate to guarantee the stated exchange; if only one side delegates, cancel to prevent unilateral exploitation and protect me from unfavorable mediated terms.
Guarantee intended trades only when both sides delegate (prevents defection). If only one side delegates, cancel to avoid asymmetric risk and token loss.
Execute fair terms only when both parties delegate to prevent exploitation; cancel when delegation is unilateral to avoid one-sided advantage and protect peace.
When both parties delegate, enforce the exact agreed terms (prevents exploitation). If only one delegates, cancel to avoid one-sided locking-in and reduce risk of being gamed.
If only one side delegates, canceling preserves my ability to avoid paying when defection would be better; if both delegate, fair execution ensures guaranteed exchange and reduces opportunism.
Canceling on single-party delegation prevents one-sided exploitation; executing fairly when both delegate makes mutual delegation credible and helps maintain peace.

If both parties delegate, execute the stated terms to guarantee exchange. If only one delegates, cancel to avoid enabling one-sided, non-consensual extraction; this discourages defection and helps maintain peace.

elected_mediator.rationale: Guarantees mutual delegation results in fair trades, but prevents unilateral delegation from forcing me into a mediated exchange where the other side could defect; cancel avoids one-sided disadvantage. Mediation fee is only paid when delegation occurs.
